scenes.say: You wake up. Every bridge on Earth is gone.
The U.S. alone has about 624,000 bridges. All of them, gone overnight.

scenes.body:
bridges and tunnels.
Manhattan is an island again.
scenes.say: New York City loses 789 bridges and tunnels. Manhattan is an island again.

scenes.body:
Trucks can't cross rivers.
Groceries stop arriving.
scenes.say: Trucks can't cross rivers. Grocery shelves start emptying in days.

scenes.body:
Every rail line dead-ends
at the water's edge.
scenes.say: Trains stop dead at every river. Freight piles up on the banks.
Hamburg, Germany, loses about 2,500 bridges. It turns into islands.

scenes.body: Every ferry is booked for months.
scenes.say: Ferries and boats become the most valuable thing in the world.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
